systems.system: Rehabilitation and equipment of the Bossangoa mairie
systems.country_label: mairie de Bossangoa réhabilitée (Programme de stabilisation)
systems.platform: solar panels installed; computer equipment for digitising civil registry documents announced as the next step
systems.owner: UNDP, financed by the European Union (one million euros), with the Ministère de l'Administration du Territoire and the local authorities of Ouham
systems.tiers: one commune office, Bossangoa; paper civil registers distributed to several communes

note: The rehabilitated Bossangoa mairie, visited on 23 April 2026, has solar power and offices, with computer equipment still to come; no connection at the office is stated, and equipment gives no fact.
